intro: Aston Villa look to kickstart their UEFA Champions League qualification bid against an out-of-sorts Sunderland side desperate to escape the relegation places.
h2h: Villa have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Sunderland (W5, D6), and are unbeaten across the last seven competitive H2Hs they hosted (W3, D4).
datos: A joint league-high 80% of Villa’s home Premier League matches this term saw both teams score.
Only one side have recorded fewer shots on target than Villa (33) in the Premier League this term.
Sunderland have led just one league game at half-time this season (HT: D6, L3).
Sunderland have faced 4+ shots on target in each of their last seven league fixtures.
Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Only two players have more Premier League goals this season than Villa’s Nicolas Jackson (6), three of which came before the 15th minute. Enzo Le Fée scored Sunderland’s winner last time out, with each of his four goals this season coming from the penalty spot.
Johan Manzambi and Matty Cash headline Villa’s injury list, while Sunderland could be without key duo Granit Xhaka and Brian Brobbey for this one.
For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.
With Sunderland struggling on their travels but Villa strong on home soil, backing the hosts to win and score multiple goals in the process seems like a good option.
